text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — our AWS Marketplace statement for Apr shows a -$52,147 payout (line item: 'Reserved capacity adjustments') vs our internal ledger which shows credits applied on May 2. Looks like a timing mismatch between AWS payout and our accounting. gs://redwood-finance/marketplace/2026/april_recon.csv :eyes:

billing-bot: Monthly marketplace statement processed for account acc-1234, file id: stmt-202604-aws.csv

Jay: I'm on it. Running Athena crosswalk of usage -> marketplace report, will paste results when ready.

Jay: Athena query results: marketplace shows adjustment for invoice INV-7890 dated 2026-04-30; our meter shows credits posted 2026-05-02. Seems AWS applied the adjustment in the April statement window but our ingestion pipeline picked up the credit on May 2.

Jay: Command I ran: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, statement_date, sum(adjustment_usd) AS adjustment
FROM aws_marketplace_statements
WHERE statement_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY invoice_id, statement_date;
```

Sana: Also flagging GCP reseller — last month they split a committed-credit adjustment across two feeds because of the reseller mapping change. If our pipeline ingested both raw + adjusted feeds we might double-count in Apr.

Tomas: Sales note: reseller contract migration completed Mar 29 and we did get two reconciliation files during cutover. I pinged accounting at the time but might have slipped through.

Eli: For bookkeeping: propose we book a timing accrual for the full $52,147 in Apr and reverse in May once adjustments land. I can run a script to compute daily accruals and provide journal entries.

Morgan: Agreed. Can someone own the AWS support ticket? We need official confirmation and corrected statement file.

Jay: I'll open the case. Filing now. Case# AWS-112233. Linking case notes and will post updates.

Jay: AWS support responded: they confirm an internal settlement lag on their payouts side. They recommend aligning on the statement_run_date when mapping to our GL. They also provided a corrected statement: s3://aws-marketplace/adjusted/stmt-202604-corrected.csv

Morgan: Great. Sana, can you verify GCP raw vs adjusted feeds and confirm we didn't ingest both? If you confirm, finance can apply corrections.

Sana: I dug into GCP. There were two files: 'reseller_adjusted_20260429.csv' and 'reseller_raw_20260430.csv'. Our pipeline ingested both because the adjust flag was missing in the raw file header. I reprocessed to drop the raw and re-run reconciliation — delta ~ $8,904 in our favor. I pushed cleaned file to accounting bucket.

Tomas: Sales will notify the affected reseller contacts and update the contract migration playbook so we don't get duplicate feeds next time.

Morgan: Actions recap: Jay — AWS ticket owner (AWS-112233). Sana — reprocess GCP and push cleaned file (done). Eli — create accrual journal and send PR. Tom — confirm sales comms. I'll update exec summary and adjust monthly close notes.

billing-bot: Recon task created: FIN-2026-042-recon, assigned to morgan, due 2026-05-05.

Jay: After ingesting AWS corrected statement and Sana's GCP reprocess, the gap shrinks: original gap $52,147 -> remaining $41,243. Sana's cleanup accounted for $10,904. Remaining $41,243 looks like pure timing.

Morgan: Perfect. Finance to book accrual for $41,243 for Apr and reverse in May. Eli, can you open PR?

Eli: PR created: https://git.redwood/finance/ledger/pulls/3421. Journal entry added with description 'AWS/GCP marketplace timing accrual Apr 2026'.

Morgan: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll close thread when GL is updated and FIN ticket is resolved.

Jay: I'll keep the AWS case open until they confirm settlement windows are stable. Posting case link in FIN ticket.

Sana: I've added a validation in the ingest pipeline to reject duplicate feeds with overlapping statement_run_date + invoice_id. Will roll out tomorrow to prod.

Tomas: Noted — I'll add a step to the migration checklist to coordinate the 'adjusted' vs 'raw' feed naming.

Morgan: Nice — closing loop soon. If anyone sees remaining deltas after GL close, ping here and we'll reopen the recon.
